Body.Content: Visual Studio Online, a web-based companion to Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code, enables developers to work on and edit code from any device with a modern web browser.  Built for productivity while on the go, this solution helps developers perform quick tasks, join Visual Studio Live Share sessions, or perform pull request reviews at times and in places where they may not have access to their development environment.
